instructions: Docusaurus 3 site holding Virtual Coffee's community-building docs. Nearly every PR is Markdown under docs/, often from first-time contributors, so keep feedback kind, specific and actionable. Prettier and markdownlint run in CI, so do not comment on formatting.

rules.rule: A doc added, renamed, moved or deleted under docs/ must have a matching entry change in sidebars.js. Doc IDs are the path relative to docs/ without the file extension; README.md stays as <dir>/README.
Relative links and image paths must point to files that exist in the repo. The site build fails on broken links (onBrokenLinks: 'throw').
Headings use sentence case: capitalize only the first word and proper nouns (e.g. Virtual Coffee, GitHub, Lightning Talks).
Every image must have descriptive alt text that conveys what the image shows; empty or filename-style alt text is not allowed.
